items.title: TRADITION
items.quote: G-d, we have heard with our [own] ears. Our forefathers, have related to us.
items.text: Strengthen Your emunah (faith) by recalling that the events of the past did not occur in a vacuum. Their history was passed down to from father to son, from generation to generation.

items.title: DIVINE ACTION
items.quote: You, [with] Your own hand, drove out [seven sinful] nations and planted [our forefathers in the Land of Canaan.
items.text: Renew your conviction that we committed no offense in taking possession of Eretz Canaan. It was Hashem who replaced the Canaanim because of their corrupt ways.

items.title: STRENGTH
items.quote: You have been my King, O G-d, command [Your malachim to carry out] yeshuos for Yaakov.
items.text: Ask Hashem to invoke His traditional bond with the Jewish people and save them from their enemies, even if that yeshuah is carried out by intermediaries rather than the direct hand of G-d.

items.quote: For You have saved us [in the past] from our tormentors and You shamed those who hate us.

items.title: THANKING FOR PAST GLORIES
items.quote: G-d has given us a sense of glory all the days, and we have always thanked Your Name, Selah.
items.text: Continue to thank Hashem for the past glories of our nation.

items.title: ABANDONMENT
items.quote: [But now] You have also cast us off and humiliated us.
items.text: Ask Hashem to restore His closeness to you.

items.quote: You have turned us back [in retreat] from the tormentor.

items.title: ABANDONMENT
items.quote: You made us a [tragic] symbol among the nations, [a reason] among the peoples [for] shaking [their] head.
items.text: Our humiliation is all the worse because it was imposed through the actions of Hashem and therefore symbolizes how He has distanced Himself from us.

items.title: URGENCY
items.quote: Arise to Help us! Redeem us because of Your kindness.
items.text: Ask Hashem not to wait any longer, but to bring the yeshuah now. It is urgently needed.
